subject: Sandbox -> Prod Metering cutover & entitlement checks for AcmeCorp
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmecorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace-onboarding@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Moving metering from sandbox to production / PO and contract questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're ready to move the metering and fulfillment flow we tested in sandbox into production for a limited subset of customers next month. A couple quick asks before we cut over: 

- Confirm the SaaS contract amendment language you need from us for entitlement mapping (we have a standard clause but legal wants to be explicit about usage metering).
- We will issue a PO today (attached as a placeholder). Do you need DocuSign countersignature before the marketplace activation?
- There were a few sandbox events where the entitlement key didn't map (tenant-level seat vs. account-level seat). Can you confirm what data points Redwood needs in the webhook payload to guarantee correct entitlement attribution?

If easier, happy to hop on a short call later today.

Cheers,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform Integrations | AcmeCorp
[Attachment: acme_po_20260814.pdf (application/pdf, 21KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmecorp.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace-onboarding@amazon.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Moving metering from sandbox to production / PO and contract questions

Oliver —

Great to hear you're ready to cut over. Below is a concise plan and the items we need from Acme to avoid common production pitfalls. I've attached a one-page checklist for your engineering and procurement teams.

Plan (target rollout window: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-07 for initial customers)
- Week of 8/17: legal sign-off on SLA + entitlement amendment; procurement issues PO + DocuSign (if required).
- 8/24–8/28: production sandbox mirror testing (traffic to prod meter endpoints with test keys).
- 9/1: enable metering in production for canary customers. Monitor for mapping failures and billing spikes.

What Redwood needs from Acme now
1) Contract amendment language: we require a short clause referencing "per-tenant usage metering via AWS Marketplace SaaS metering; entitlements are derived from the marketplace entitlement payload and your upstream tenant_id/seat_count mapping." Our legal team can provide a suggested paragraph — if you prefer to redline, send your draft.
2) Webhook payload mapping: please include these fields in your fulfillment webhook and metering events: tenant_id, acme_account_id, entitlement_type (seat|seat_proxy), seat_count, marketplace_entitlement_id, region. If you can't include marketplace_entitlement_id in your initial events, we can fallback to matching on tenant_id + acme_account_id but that increases reconciliation error risk.
3) PO & DocuSign: PO received (thanks). We typically accept a signed SaaS Addendum via DocuSign before enabling production fulfillment. The DocuSign link is in the checklist.

Attachments: metering_integration_checklist.xlsx — covers payload samples, expected responses, and a preflight test suite.

Next steps: Ben, can you start the entitlement mapping runbook and confirm required engineering support? Monica/Karthik — tagging you for procurement and partner listing alignment. Oliver — if you confirm the timeline and can share a redline or accept our suggested paragraph by 8/18, we'll lock the rollout window.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partner Lead, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: metering_integration_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Moving metering from sandbox to production / PO and contract questions

Team — forwarding Acme's note and our reply. TL;DR: they will sign the addendum if we provide a short suggested paragraph by EOD Monday; they have sent a placeholder PO.

Ben — can you prepare an entitlement mapping runbook with the following: 
- deterministic matching flow (marketplace_entitlement_id preferred -> tenant_id -> acme_account_id)
- reconciliation job cadence and alert thresholds (1% mapping failures allowed during canary, ticket to SalesOps on >1%).
- corrective actions for seat_proxy vs seat (how we transform seat_proxy into billable seat counts).

Karthik — please confirm the marketplace listing metadata (SKU, fulfillment type, entitlement granularity) is aligned with the runbook assumptions. If we need to change the SKU mapping we'll need to update AWS listing and notify Acme; that will add 3 business days.

Monica — procurement question: do we require DocuSign before we flip canary to prod? My read: yes, but if Acme needs a short grace period we can provisionally enable production with a billing hold and require DocuSign within 5 business days. Is that acceptable from a risk perspective?

I'll collect the runbook and legal paragraph and loop back to Acme. Thanks.

—
Vanessa

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmecorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace-onboarding@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Moving metering from sandbox to production / PO and contract questions

Vanessa, Ben, team —

Appreciate the clear plan. We accept Redwood's suggested approach. Specifics: 
- Legal: we will review your suggested paragraph and aim to return an unsigned redline or acceptance by COB Monday 8/17.
- Engineering: we'll instrument the payload fields you listed; our engineering lead will run the preflight tests the week of 8/24.
- Procurement: the attached PO is a placeholder while we complete DocuSign. We can accept a 5-business-day grace as long as billing holds are available during initial canary.

One last ask: can you add a short sample event (JSON) to the checklist showing tenant_id -> marketplace_entitlement_id mapping? That helps our SRE reproduce the exact mapping.

If that's all, please proceed and we'll be on standby for the runbook and paragraph.

Thanks,
Oliver
